title: Rick Explains Binary Search in 60 Seconds!
caption: Why binary search is the ultimate hack for fast searching! 🔍 #ProgrammingTips

scenes.script: Alright, Morty! You ever get tired of searching through a list like a dumb human?
Uh, sure Rick. What's the big deal? Just check each one!
scenes.character_image: volume/resources/LoreLabs/images/morty/morty looking to another side without caring.png

scenes.script: Exactly! Like searching for a sandwich in a fridge full of gross alien food. Binary search cuts this in half every time!
Wait, how? You just look at the middle and decide?
Bingo! Start with two pointers, L and R. Middle element M is (L+R)/2. If target's lower, search left; else right.
So it's like finding the right temperature for a bath by adjusting hot and cold taps?
scenes.character_image: volume/resources/LoreLabs/images/morty/morty with a dumb looking without understanding.png

scenes.script: Exactly! Keep halving until you hit zero. Time complexity? O(log n), Morty. Faster than your brain!
But what if the array is empty or the target isn’t there? Wait, no! It’s infinite, Rick!
scenes.character_image: volume/resources/LoreLabs/images/morty/morty super angry biting his lips and frowning.png

scenes.script: Easy. Set L=-1, R=n. Avoids boundary errors like a pro. And for overflow? Use l + (r - l) / 2.
So binary search isn’t just for arrays, right? It can find max/min or even solve equations?
You’re catching on! Monotonic functions, real numbers—it’s all about the same logic. Just tweak the predicate.
But what if I mess up? Like off-by-one errors or integer overflows?
scenes.character_image: volume/resources/LoreLabs/images/morty/morty with a dumb looking without understanding.png

scenes.script: Pfft! Test edge cases, use safe formulas. Now go code something useful for once.
